text:
BEEP announces Kurutta Kajitsu: Tsukishima Minatsu ASMR



A horror ASMR based on a VN originally released almost 35 years ago



You grow closer to Minatsu, but strange things begin to happen. 



You hear a noise from behind a closed door, but she tells you it's just a dog.

She tells you about a "drug" capable of robbing a person of their free will.

A woman you had feelings for suddenly disappears.

When you decide to leave, Minatsu offers you one last cup of tea...



Illustrated by Asahi, the mangaka behind Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Oni, as well as the writer of Geminism and a currently untitled Liar-soft game



Written by Minagishi Jun'ichi, who contributed to the Windmill's Campanella series and Hulotte's Orefukashi



ICYMI: Kurutta Kajitsu received a remaster this year and was translated into English by Kagami Games



January 31

text:
If There Is a God in This World announced for Steam



An unhinged dark otome by Rejet, the developer of Diabolik Lovers and Black Wolves Saga



Keep in mind that the Steam description reveals much more of the plot than the original version's description that you can see below



Haruka receives a mysterious letter from herself from seven years earlier. She decides it's just a joke, but then discovers that some of her classmates have also received similar letters



Strange events start to happen, laying bare the long-hidden scars of Haruka and her friends. Eventually, they realize... Something is wrong with this "world"



The Steam version will be available in Japanese and Chinese. It will be published by Beijing Happy Entertainment Technology, which also published Ken ga Kimi and Yoshiwara Higanbana



The VN was originally released for PS Vita in 2016 and received a Switch port in 2025



Main characters are voiced by Midorikawa Hikaru, Suwabe Jun'ichi, Kaji Yuuki, Toriumi Kousuke, and Namikawa Daisuke



Release date TBA

Yen Press announces It’s a Little Late, but I’ve Fallen in Love with My Childhood Friend



A manga written by Maruto Fumiaki (White Album 2) and illustrated by Yom (Ganbare Douki-chan)



Hikari Shirasaka has only ever seen Taa-kun as a childhood friend…that is, until she fell for him a year ago. Now determined to steal his heart, she’s pulling all the stops, from classic moves like waking him up in the morning to initiating an indirect kiss! But the guy doesn’t seem to be affected one bit…Is he truly uninterested in her, or could there be a tangled web of secrets hidden beneath his unbothered exterior? Will Hikari’s fiery love spark into a blazing romance, or will she be scorched by the flames…?



Originally a web novel, there is also a light novel version of the story

text:
[Official TL] YOZAKURA reveals release dates for some upcoming Liar-soft titles



December 18: Twilight Pretender

January 18: Shunx's Tyrhia ~ What a Beautiful Dawn ~



Twilight Pretender (JP title: Tasogare no Shapeshifter) is currently Liar-soft's latest VN. It was created by the team behind Gakuen Inkitan, a highly rated supernatural drama and semi-nukige



It's a human drama about university students. Hiroto is confronted by his mentally unstable ex-girlfriend, who asks him to give her another chance. The thing is, her body has been taken by a "shapeshifter" named Eiko



If Hiroto agrees to be Eiko's boyfriend for a while, she will release his ex. But soon enough, Hiroto realizes that he's more compatible with Eiko than with his ex. Even though it's just a temporary relationship, he finally remembers what it means to love and be loved. However, the moment of a final, bittersweet choice draws closer...



Current EGS score: 80/100 (based on 112 votes)



Shunx's Tyrhia (JP title: Shunkyoku no Tyrhhia) is currently the latest VN in the Steampunk series created by Sakurai Hikaru



It's based on a doujin short story originally created by Sakurai Hikaru and artist Kiryuu Mina in 2011



Since Sakurai left Liar-soft to pursue a freelance career, the VN was mostly written by other writers led by Nogi Funasato, who is known for Jeanne at the Clock Tower



The VN was supposed to be the first entry in the Steampunk revival project, but we haven't seen any new titles in the past 8 years



Current EGS score: 74/100 (based on 72 votes)



Warning: many of YOZAKURA's previous translations have been called extremely low-quality MTLs, so keep this in mind and be careful



Steam:

• https://nitter.cf/t.co/CAJIhpzt6k

• https://nitter.cf/t.co/edl42GGOHz
